title: NAT Gateway and Security Layers
prompt: Extend the VPC design to include a NAT Gateway enabling private subnet instances to access the internet. Add security groups and Network ACLs to demonstrate the layered security model.
hints: Place the NAT Gateway in the public subnet
Add a route from the private subnet's route table to the NAT Gateway
Show security groups attached to instances and NACLs at subnet boundaries
Remember: security groups are stateful, NACLs are stateless
